newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania takes 25,000 T of wheat from reserves.
newsitem.headline: Romania takes 25,000 T of wheat from reserves.

text.p: Romania will take 25,000 tonnes of wheat from its strategic reserves and blend it with part of the newly harvested 1997 wheat crop to compensate for quality, Agriculture Minister Dinu Gavrilescu said on Friday.
"The new wheat crop is still unfit for milling so we decided to use 25,000 tonnes of wheat from the state reserves in order to get an acceptable mixture for bakeries," he said.
Romania's 1997 crop is seen at 6.9 million tonnes, compared with 3.1 million tonnes last year.
Gavrilescu said heavy rains and floods in recent weeks had damaged 900,000 tonnes of wheat.
He put Romania's strategic wheat reserves at 350,000 tonnes.
